# Security reporting

Report vulnerabilities privately through [Bodhinox Chat GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/UDAY368/bodhinox_chat/security/advisories/new). Do not include credentials or customer data in a public issue.

Include the affected commit, impact and minimal reproduction. If private reporting is unavailable, contact the repository owner privately before sharing exploit details. This project does not designate the upstream maintainer or their employer as its support team.

Application code, authentication, tenant isolation, webhook verification and deployment defaults are in scope for this repository. Dependency vulnerabilities should also be reported to the relevant upstream maintainer.

Use isolated test accounts and data when reproducing issues. Avoid access to other tenants, service disruption or deletion of customer data. This reporting guide does not grant access to any deployment.
